Do not estimate or cite measurements for candidates. Keep all text fields concise and evidence-specific.

decision.critic: The tool estimates are fitted predictions, not measured fluorescence; they cannot confirm the hypothesis or establish actual brightness. The strongest direct support is for N144Y, but C16 adds an untested N23S edit.
decision.selection_rationale: Prioritize C17 (estimate 3.672) and C22 (3.665), followed by C41 (3.565), C16 (3.549), and C47 (3.544). O6 supports N144Y in C16; O9 supports the I161 position in C22, though not the exact I161L edit. The remaining choices have no direct mutation-level support in the cited observations. Test whether options with higher estimates, especially those containing an observed favorable edit, retain brightness.
